Beacon Business — Privacy Policy

Beacon of the Eagle LLC · Effective November 22, 2026 · Android versions 1.0.0–1.0.3

EnglishEspañolItaliano

English

Beacon Business is an offline business organization application provided by Beacon of the Eagle LLC. It does not require an account.

Information you enter. You may enter business transactions, contact names, email addresses, phone numbers, project details, tasks and notes. These records, your progress and your language preference are stored locally in the app’s private WebView storage on your device. They are not sent to us.

No collection or sharing by the developer. The Android app has no Internet permission, advertising, analytics, tracking SDKs or cloud synchronization. We do not receive, collect, sell or share the information you enter. Core features work offline. The app does not access your contacts, location, camera, microphone or photo library.

Exports. When you choose Export, Android asks you where to save a JSON backup or CSV report. A file you choose to place in another provider, such as cloud storage, is handled according to that provider’s practices. Exported JSON and CSV files are not encrypted by this app; keep it in a location you trust.

Restoring a backup. You may choose a compatible JSON file through Android’s document picker. The app validates it locally and shows a review before replacing records. A previous-state copy is kept locally so you can undo the most recent restoration; clearing app storage removes this copy too. Backup files are not sent to us.

Retention and deletion. Records remain on the device until you remove them or clear the app’s storage. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes local records. Copies you exported remain wherever you saved them and must be removed separately. Automatic Android backup is disabled by the app. Individual deletion offers a short undo period in the app.

Your control. You decide which information to enter and export. Only enter contact or business data you are authorized to use. The app is intended for business users and is not designed for children.

Contact and updates. For privacy questions, contact centinellsuite@gmail.com. Changes to this policy will be reflected in an updated effective date. This policy describes the Android app; the separate hosted website is subject to the hosting service’s account and access practices.

Español

Beacon Business es una aplicación de organización empresarial sin conexión de Beacon of the Eagle LLC. No requiere una cuenta.

Puedes introducir movimientos, nombres, correos, teléfonos, proyectos, tareas y notas. Los registros, avances e idioma se guardan localmente en el almacenamiento privado de WebView en tu dispositivo. No se nos envían. La app Android no tiene permiso de Internet, publicidad, analítica, rastreadores ni sincronización en la nube. No recibimos, recopilamos, vendemos ni compartimos tus datos. No accede a contactos, ubicación, cámara, micrófono ni fotos.

Al exportar, Android te permite elegir dónde guardar el archivo JSON. Si eliges un proveedor externo, se aplican sus prácticas. La app no cifra el archivo exportado. Los datos locales permanecen hasta que los elimines, borres el almacenamiento de la app o la desinstales. Las copias exportadas deben eliminarse por separado. La copia automática de Android está desactivada. La eliminación individual ofrece un breve período para deshacer.

Introduce únicamente datos cuyo uso tengas autorizado. La app está dirigida a usuarios empresariales, no a niños. Contacto: centinellsuite@gmail.com. Las actualizaciones se reflejarán en la fecha de vigencia. Esta política describe la app Android; el sitio web separado utiliza las prácticas de acceso de su alojamiento.

Italiano

Beacon Business è un’applicazione offline per l’organizzazione aziendale fornita da Beacon of the Eagle LLC. Non richiede un account.

Puoi inserire movimenti, nomi, email, telefoni, progetti, attività e note. Dati, progressi e lingua vengono salvati localmente nello spazio privato WebView del dispositivo e non ci vengono inviati. L’app Android non ha il permesso Internet, pubblicità, analisi, tracciamento o sincronizzazione cloud. Non riceviamo, raccogliamo, vendiamo o condividiamo i dati inseriti. Non accede a contatti, posizione, fotocamera, microfono o foto.

Durante l’esportazione Android ti permette di scegliere dove salvare un file JSON o CSV. Se scegli un fornitore esterno, si applicano le sue pratiche. Il file esportato non viene cifrato dall’app. I dati locali restano fino alla loro eliminazione, alla cancellazione dei dati dell’app o alla disinstallazione. Le copie esportate vanno eliminate separatamente. Il backup automatico Android è disattivato. L’eliminazione individuale offre un breve periodo per annullare.

Inserisci solo dati che sei autorizzato a utilizzare. L’app è destinata a utenti aziendali, non ai bambini. Contatto: centinellsuite@gmail.com. Gli aggiornamenti saranno indicati dalla data di efficacia. Questa informativa riguarda l’app Android; il sito web separato segue le pratiche di accesso del proprio fornitore.
